summary: The exact Nsight Systems/CUDA process-tree hang could not be reproduced because the assigned host has one AMD gfx950 GPU and no nsys executable. The actual checked-out sglang serve path did reach readiness and execute four GPU-backed HTTP probes with a deterministic tiny Llama fixture, so no issue-specific source correction was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Nsight Systems availability; no executable was found (evidence/nsys-path.txt is empty).

Actual source-checkout CLI serving path via sglang.cli.main serve: readiness in 25.040 seconds; HTTP 200 for generate, OpenAI completion, two-request batch, and streaming completion with eight SSE events; owned process group removed after cleanup.

tests.command: GitHub API inspection of sgl-project/sglang issue 33283, comments, and searches for nsys/Nsight issues and pull requests
tests.what_was_measured: The source issue remained open with no comments, and no issue-linked existing fix was identified before testing. Raw issue and comment responses are retained under evidence/source-issue/.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 execution is recorded in evidence/environment.txt. evidence/cli-direct/server.log records model loading and GPU prefill/decode execution; evidence/cli-direct/probe-summary.json records four HTTP 200 responses and eight stream events. This is not NVIDIA/Nsight qualification.

remaining_limitations: The assigned accelerator is AMD gfx950, while the report is specific to NVIDIA Nsight Systems and CUDA on an RTX 4060 Ti.
Nsight Systems (nsys) is not installed, so the profiler process-tree command and its CUDA/osrt injection behavior could not be exercised.
Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B weights were not available; the deterministic tiny random Llama validates transport and engine execution only, not Qwen architecture or semantic accuracy.
No failing-before/passing-after regression was added because the issue-specific failure was not reproduced and no narrow correction had evidentiary support.
